newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian central bank keeps rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian central bank keeps rates unchanged.

text.p: Indonesian central bank, Bank Indonesia, kept its interest rates for bilateral papers (SBIs) unchanged on Monday, dealers said.
The bank offered one-to-three-day bilateral SBIs at 14.0 percent, one-week at 10.0 percent, two-week at 10.5 percent, one-month at 10.5, three at 11.0, six at 11.625 and one-year at 12.25 percent.
The central bank raised the rate for one-week papers to 10.0 percent on Friday from eight percent on Thursday and for two-week papers to 10.5 percent from 8.5 percent.
Dealers said the bank was still absent from the short-term securities (SBPUs) market.
